description: Read duration, dimensions, and video/audio codec identifiers from a QuickTime .mov file's moov/mvhd/trak atoms, plus the mvhd creation/modification dates and any udta user-data metadata tags (title, artist, copyright, description, etc). No frame is ever decoded, demuxed, or transcoded.

mov_base64.description: Base64-encoded QuickTime .mov file bytes, optionally prefixed with a data: URL scheme

name: read_quicktime_metadata
